mapper.select: SELECT id FROM coupon_reward_rule WHERE event_type=#{event} AND status='active' FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_reward_record (id,user_id,event_type,source_id,rule_id,reward_status,ineligible_reason,occurred_at,next_retry_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{id},#{user},#{event},#{source},#{rule}, 'pending''not_eligible', #{reason},#{now},#{now}NULL,#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=coupon_reward_record.id
